gate: min per-sheet gate_iou against 0.75. Partial sheets use min(registration IoU, full hydro IoU). combined_iou is not the gate.

selection.code:
candidates = sorted(wbic for wbic in doclink_wbics if wbic not in pilots)
random.Random(9288).shuffle(candidates)
Keep a lake when 24K Hydro returns a polygon and every doclink PDF downloads. Stop at 30 extras. Pilots are always included. The first 30 shuffled candidates were all kept.
